name: Game-Theory Adversary
description: Devil's-advocate critique of a diligence record (and optionally the generated memo) through three game-theoretic lenses: signaling (Spence/Akerlof), auction (winner's-curse on comparables), and Bayesian persuasion (selective disclosure). Outputs structured findings with severity tags and a verdict on whether the adversarial pass upgrades, holds, or downgrades the recommendation.
